facts.text: Yuvasının girişini dallar, taşlar ve eşyalarla örtüyor.

facts.text: İnsanlara yakınsa süpürge ve masa gibi eşyaları bile biriktiriyor.

facts.text: Ailesinin en büyük türü; dokuz kiloya kadar çıkabiliyor.

en.title: A Rodent That Blocks Its Door With Junk! What Is It?
en.description: The plains viscacha covers its burrow entrance with branches, stones and even household objects such as brooms collected near people. The largest of its family, it reaches 9 kg on South American grasslands.
